contracts.title: Programme set-up: evidence repository, contract register and seed-gate script
contracts.closes: Enabler: a place to hold non-code evidence and one command that reports every contract

contracts.title: Seed gate: every seed-readiness contract verifies PASS
contracts.closes: Not investable at seed: every gap above must be closed (the analysis verdict)

contracts.title: One writer, enforced: an exclusive lock on the vault log
contracts.closes: Single-writer rule is convention only; runner.mjs opens a Vault beside a live daemon and can corrupt the oplog

contracts.title: No AI-drafted command runs without local approval
contracts.closes: Contract verify runs sh -c commands a local session drafted and signed in one turn (contracts.mjs:213-228)

contracts.title: Replay protection that survives a restart
contracts.closes: The nonce cache is in-memory, so a daemon restart reopens the five-minute replay window

contracts.title: Cloud connectors: no bearer in the URL, proof of possession
contracts.closes: Connector URLs embed the bearer token in the path (logged by tunnel providers); cloud tokens are plain replayable bearers

contracts.title: A bounded rate limiter
contracts.closes: The rate limiter bucket map is never evicted (http.mjs:69-77), an unbounded memory growth on a public tunnel

contracts.title: One licence schema, validated everywhere
contracts.closes: LICENSE_FIELDS omits trial, org and trial_ext that other modules read; installLicense skips the check activate applies

contracts.title: Pinned TLS on the relay and a configured OAuth issuer
contracts.closes: Relay client uses rejectUnauthorized:false with name pinning; the OAuth issuer is derived from the Host header

contracts.title: Remote setup session: allowlist that works, tested like the rest
contracts.closes: setup-remote.mjs allowlists a deployment command the deployment module cannot accept; no SPDX header; one test file

contracts.title: Code a second engineer can read
contracts.closes: 300 to 600 character lines, server imports CLI, helpers duplicated three times, empty catch blocks hide faults

contracts.title: A suite that is green on any machine
contracts.closes: 12 tests need ssh-keygen, 8 need an authenticated gh and network, 3 fail when MEMEV_NO_SERVICE is set

contracts.title: memev stop always ends inside its bound
contracts.closes: REV-022 AC03 is a real flake: stop takes 5.2 s on 2 vCPU and the daemon is SIGKILLed mid shutdown-sync

contracts.title: CI that protects main
contracts.closes: Linux tests run only on pull requests, docs-only changes skip CI although tests assert on docs, no macOS job, no coverage

contracts.title: Performance numbers anyone can reproduce
contracts.closes: Docs and site claim 1.1 ms recall and 160 MB heap with no hardware; measured 4.55 ms and 183 MB

contracts.title: The multilingual claim runs in the suite
contracts.closes: The 26-query, 9-script claim lives in an unwired lab script; the suite tests 7 queries

contracts.title: No code without a caller
contracts.closes: project-state.mjs (330 lines) and the oplog HLC merge helpers have no production caller; entitlements name features with nothing behind them

contracts.title: Docs and code say the same thing
contracts.closes: Help omits real subcommands; CLIENTS.md says sync every few minutes (default 30); delete is not reconciled; dependency claim overstated

contracts.title: A bus that scales to a team
contracts.closes: Bus.all() re-sorts every message per call; roster and tasks are O(seats x messages)

contracts.title: Windows out of preview
contracts.closes: parentProcName has no Windows path; installer is win-x64 only; Windows CI runs 6 files; no lab run

contracts.title: The lab plan is run, not just written
contracts.closes: 143 manual lab cases; no evidence any were run

contracts.title: External security review before any public launch
contracts.closes: OAuth server, tunnel exposure, device signing, rate limiting and setup channel have had no outside review

contracts.title: Recall that finds paraphrases
contracts.closes: Recall is BM25 only; a query with no shared words scores zero

contracts.title: A public memory benchmark
contracts.closes: No LongMemEval or LoCoMo number; buyers ask for one

contracts.title: Every client hook verified against the real app
contracts.closes: Codex, Gemini and Windsurf env markers admitted unverified (common.mjs:80); a vendor change silently breaks hooks

contracts.title: Continuity measured in every app, including those without hooks
contracts.closes: Claude Desktop, VS Code, Zed and Windsurf get instructions only; the compaction benchmark across apps is planned

contracts.title: Catch restatements and count confirmations
contracts.closes: A restatement in different words gets through; a repeated save is discarded instead of counted

contracts.title: One rules file for every app
contracts.closes: Planned: one rules file written into CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md and Cursor rules

contracts.title: Project names in any script
contracts.closes: Project names written only in non-Latin scripts collapse to the same file name

contracts.title: A local read-only view of the vault
contracts.closes: Planned: a small read-only web view so a person can browse memory, why and provenance

contracts.title: Grok: build it or stop showing it
contracts.closes: The site shows Grok as coming soon; nothing in the product repo supports it

contracts.title: Engine decision: what merges a note, where it lives, how it is licensed
contracts.closes: crdt-merge is presented as the paid core but merges tensors and records, not Markdown; the engine has no design

contracts.title: An engine conformance suite in the core
contracts.closes: The service contract in PAID-CONVERGENCE.md has no executable test any engine must pass

contracts.title: The text merge engine, built and passing conformance
contracts.closes: The feature the $12 tier advertises, automatic merge across computers, does not exist

contracts.title: Several computers editing one vault at once, nothing to resolve
contracts.closes: Git sync is single-writer and advisory; the oplog HLC merge has no caller; a second writer leaves conflict copies

contracts.title: One licence for the engine, stated once
contracts.closes: The engine licence is stated three ways (BSL 1.1, FSL-1.1-ALv2, draft BUSL-1.1 with licensor to be confirmed)

contracts.title: Know what the patents cover
contracts.closes: Two UK patent applications on CRDT model merging; no claims map against Memev and no freedom-to-operate note

contracts.title: One architecture for personal and company data
contracts.closes: memev-cloud says servers never read vault content; the Business design says the company server reads everything

contracts.title: A licence server that issues and activates licences
contracts.closes: No licence server exists; memev license activate has nothing to call

contracts.title: End-to-end encrypted sync between one person's computers
contracts.closes: Hosted E2E sync is planned and memev-cloud has no code

contracts.title: A hosted relay with a stable address
contracts.closes: The relay protocol and client exist; no hosted relay or stable address does

contracts.title: Hosted encrypted backup
contracts.closes: Hosted encrypted backup is planned; only GitHub backup exists

contracts.title: Run the hosted services like a business
contracts.closes: No operations: no monitoring, status page, backups of the services themselves or incident process

contracts.title: People can pay: live checkout, webhook, licence by email
contracts.closes: Stripe is in test mode; no webhook, no licence email; the paid tier cannot be bought

contracts.title: The Business trial can actually start
contracts.closes: invite.trialAvailable() returns false (MEM-067); the site offers a trial no one can start

contracts.title: Referral credit
contracts.closes: REFERRAL.md is a draft spec with nothing built

contracts.title: Paid tiers sell only what is built, on every surface
contracts.closes: The $12 tier advertises automatic merge, which does not exist; the pricing test covers docs but not the site

contracts.title: A rate card for Business and Corporate
contracts.closes: Business and Corporate are contact-us with no price logic; services are day rates on request

contracts.title: Support the company can actually deliver
contracts.closes: Paid support has no address; Corporate promises 1-hour 24/7 response and embedded engineers a one-person company cannot give

contracts.title: The repository goes public
contracts.closes: The repository is private, so no one can find, star or install it

contracts.title: npx memev init works
contracts.closes: Not on npm; the one-command install path is coming soon

contracts.title: Installers and a container anyone can fetch
contracts.closes: Installers have no download URL; the Docker image is on no registry

contracts.title: Listed where people look for MCP servers
contracts.closes: MCP and connector directory entries are drafts marked do not post

contracts.title: A site that leads to the product
contracts.closes: The site links to no repository, registry or installer; every call to action is a mailto

contracts.title: The site says only what is true
contracts.closes: The site shows automatic merge, a free cloud trial, a company vault and 24-hour offboarding as available; all are planned

contracts.title: One positioning, chosen and used everywhere
contracts.closes: Three taglines in circulation; memory, coordination and governance all claimed; platform memory erodes the memory-only pitch

contracts.title: Proof that people use it
contracts.closes: No users, waitlist, metrics or retention anywhere

contracts.title: A name the company can own
contracts.closes: Memev collides with memecoin and MEV search results; no trademark search or filing for Memev or Proofline

contracts.title: A company vault European works councils will accept
contracts.closes: "The company sees everything a member syncs" will meet works-council and privacy objections in CH and the EU, as the FAQ admits

contracts.title: A company server with accounts
contracts.closes: The company server, the host of every Business feature, does not exist

contracts.title: Members, keys and invites
contracts.closes: Member keys, org-admin invites and separate personal and company identities are planned

contracts.title: Promote up, company knowledge down
contracts.closes: The company vault that members sync into and learn from is planned and depends on an engine that did not exist

contracts.title: An admin console
contracts.closes: The admin console that sees and searches the company vault is planned

contracts.title: Offboarding inside the time the site promises
contracts.closes: The site promises access removed within 24 hours; offboarding (revoke, remove devices, wipe cache) is planned

contracts.title: Sign in with Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID
contracts.closes: SSO is planned; companies will not buy without it

contracts.title: Roles and path grants from the org chart
contracts.closes: Departments, roles and deny-by-default path grants are planned; oversharing is the top enterprise risk

contracts.title: Control what reaches the AI provider
contracts.closes: Labels, egress rules, pseudonymising and an egress log are planned

contracts.title: One AI provider per organisation
contracts.closes: Connecting one cloud AI service or an on-prem LLM for the organisation over MCP is planned

contracts.title: A Business trial that starts in minutes
contracts.closes: The site offers a free self-serve cloud trial; there is no hosted company server to start it on

contracts.title: The agent coordination control plane
contracts.closes: The bull case, vendor-neutral coordination of many agents across many vendors, is unpositioned and unbuilt beyond one person's bus

contracts.title: Two design partners in regulated SMEs
contracts.closes: No design partner, pilot or letter of intent; the Business thesis is untested

contracts.title: High availability
contracts.closes: Load-balanced, replicated, failover deployment for Corporate is planned

contracts.title: An air-gapped package
contracts.closes: The air-gapped package with signed bundle updates is planned

contracts.title: SCIM provisioning
contracts.closes: SCIM is planned

contracts.title: Audit export, retention and legal hold
contracts.closes: SIEM export, retention rules and legal hold are planned

contracts.title: Source escrow and a succession plan
contracts.closes: Escrow and succession are planned; a one-person vendor is a supplier risk for corporate buyers

contracts.title: A services catalogue matched to capacity
contracts.closes: Setup in 2 to 12 weeks, 1-hour 24/7 response and embedded engineers are offered with no one to deliver them

contracts.title: A legal entity with a published imprint
contracts.closes: No legal form, address or UID; imprints read "published shortly"; Swiss UWG identity rules unmet; domicile unclear after the move

contracts.title: Terms, privacy policy and DPA
contracts.closes: No terms of service, privacy policy for hosted services, data processing agreement or subprocessor list

contracts.title: The vendor signing key is safe and recoverable
contracts.closes: One person holds the licence private key; no custody, backup or rotation plan

contracts.title: A founder committed full time, and a focused portfolio
contracts.closes: Commitment unclear alongside a job search and relocation; attention spread over Memev, Memora, TOPC, Proofline and model-merging research

contracts.title: A second engineer and two-person review
contracts.closes: Bus factor of one; the code has never had a second human reader

contracts.title: Commercial experience on the team
contracts.closes: No commercial co-founder or advisor who has sold self-hosted developer infrastructure to European mid-market buyers

contracts.title: The company owns its IP
contracts.closes: Memev, crdt-merge, Proofline and the patent applications are held personally; an investor needs them in the company

contracts.title: A data room an investor can work from
contracts.closes: No deck, financial model, cap table or use-of-funds plan
